findings.message: Share projection evidence passes: CaseSummaryV1 includes patientRoleId, the allowlist projector removes persona/answer/rubric/hidden-fact fields, and public/runtime leakage scans report zero sensitive matches.

Thirty unique patient roles are evidenced by patient-role.public-c01 through patient-role.public-c30; the catalog check reports 30/30 unique and resolvable patientRoleId, appearance IDs, and launch tints.
The public journey reports 30 cases across 15 shifts with exactly two actor slots, npc.patient.graybox-01 and npc.patient.graybox-02, and the evidence shows paired case assignments per shift.

Session/turn identity binding passes: each evidenced case binds patientRoleId, patientNpcId, sessionId, and turn sessionId; the journey reports 30 createSession calls and 30 completed turns, while duplicate or mismatched bindings are reported to fail explicitly.
